description: Conservation of the unannotated second segment (136-153) versus the annotated TM1 (108-128) across 69 MIC26/MIC27-family orthologs, including residue 117
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, json
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

store=json.load(open("conservation_cols.json"))
pan=pd.read_csv("ortholog_panel.tsv",sep="\t").drop_duplicates("Entry")
hum=pan.loc[pan.Entry=="Q9BUR5","Sequence"].iloc[0]
segtab=pd.read_csv("ortholog_tm_segments.csv").set_index("entry")
pid=segtab["pct_id"].to_dict()

HYD=set("AVLIMFWYC")
L=198
entries=list(store)
# distant subset: <50% identity to human MIC26 (fungal, insect, plant, MIC27 paralogues)
distant=[e for e in entries if pid.get(e,100)<50]
print(f"orthologs: {len(entries)} total, {len(distant)} with <50% identity to human MIC26")

def profile(subset):
    ident=np.zeros(L); hyd=np.zeros(L); gap=np.zeros(L)
    for p in range(1,L+1):
        col=[store[e]["map"].get(str(p),"-") for e in subset]
        n=len(col)
        gap[p-1]=sum(c=="-" for c in col)/n
        ident[p-1]=sum(c==hum[p-1] for c in col)/n
        ng=[c for c in col if c!="-"]
        hyd[p-1]=(sum(c in HYD for c in ng)/len(ng)) if ng else np.nan
    return ident,hyd,gap

id_all,hy_all,gp_all=profile(entries)
id_d ,hy_d ,gp_d =profile(distant)

REG={"N-term 1-107":range(1,108),"TM1 108-128":range(108,129),"turn 129-135":range(129,136),
     "seg2 136-153":range(136,154),"C-term 154-198":range(154,199)}
rows=[]
for nm,rng in REG.items():
    ix=[p-1 for p in rng]
    rows.append(dict(region=nm,n_res=len(ix),
        ident_all=round(float(np.mean(id_all[ix])),3), ident_distant=round(float(np.mean(id_d[ix])),3),
        hydfrac_all=round(float(np.nanmean(hy_all[ix])),3), hydfrac_distant=round(float(np.nanmean(hy_d[ix])),3),
        gapfrac_distant=round(float(np.mean(gp_d[ix])),3)))
tab=pd.DataFrame(rows); print(tab.to_string(index=False))
tab.to_csv("conservation_by_region.csv",index=False)

def cmp(a,b,lab,arr):
    ia=[p-1 for p in REG[a]]; ib=[p-1 for p in REG[b]]
    u,pv=mannwhitneyu(arr[ia],arr[ib])
    print(f"{lab}: {a} median {np.median(arr[ia]):.3f} vs {b} median {np.median(arr[ib]):.3f}  U={u:.0f} p={pv:.3g}")
    return pv
print()
p1=cmp("TM1 108-128","seg2 136-153","identity (distant)",id_d)
p2=cmp("seg2 136-153","N-term 1-107","identity (distant)",id_d)
p3=cmp("seg2 136-153","C-term 154-198","identity (distant)",id_d)
p4=cmp("seg2 136-153","C-term 154-198","hydrophobic fraction (distant)",np.nan_to_num(hy_d))

# residue 117 (the patient substitution site)
c117=[store[e]["map"].get("117","-") for e in entries]
print(f"\nhuman 117 = {hum[116]}; identical in {sum(c=='I' for c in c117)}/{len(c117)} orthologs; "
      f"hydrophobic in {sum(c in HYD for c in c117 if c!='-')}/{sum(c!='-' for c in c117)}; "
      f"gapped in {sum(c=='-' for c in c117)}")
print("117 residue counts:", pd.Series([c for c in c117]).value_counts().to_dict())
print("\nmean identity of the 3 most conserved columns in seg2:",
      sorted([(round(id_d[p-1],3), p, hum[p-1]) for p in REG["seg2 136-153"]], reverse=True)[:5])

json.dump({"id_all":id_all.tolist(),"id_distant":id_d.tolist(),"hyd_distant":hy_d.tolist(),
           "n_all":len(entries),"n_distant":len(distant),
           "p_TM1_vs_seg2":float(p1),"p_seg2_vs_Nterm":float(p2),"p_seg2_vs_Cterm":float(p3)},
          open("conservation_profile.json","w"))

# ---- figure ----
fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(12,7),gridspec_kw={"height_ratios":[2,1.3]})
x=np.arange(1,L+1)
ax[0].plot(x,id_all,color="0.65",lw=1,label=f"all orthologs (n={len(entries)})")
ax[0].plot(x,id_d,color="#1f4e79",lw=1.6,label=f"distant orthologs, <50% id (n={len(distant)})")
for (nm,rng),c in zip(REG.items(),["none","#d62728","#2ca02c","#ff7f0e","none"]):
    if c=="none": continue
    ax[0].axvspan(min(rng)-0.5,max(rng)+0.5,color=c,alpha=0.18)
    ax[0].text(np.mean(list(rng)),1.04,nm.split()[0],ha="center",fontsize=9,color=c)
ax[0].axvline(117,color="k",ls=":",lw=1.2); ax[0].text(117,-0.1,"I117",ha="center",fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_xlabel("human MIC26 residue"); ax[0].set_ylabel("fraction identical to human")
ax[0].set_ylim(-0.05,1.1); ax[0].legend(fontsize=8,loc="upper left")
ax[0].set_title("Per-residue conservation of human MIC26 across 69 family orthologs")

labels=list(REG); vals=[id_d[[p-1 for p in REG[k]]] for k in labels]
bp=ax[1].boxplot(vals,labels=[l.replace(" ","\n",1) for l in labels],patch_artist=True)
for patch,c in zip(bp["boxes"],["0.8","#d62728","#2ca02c","#ff7f0e","0.8"]):
    patch.set_facecolor(c); patch.set_alpha(0.5)
ax[1].set_ylabel("identity, distant\northologs")
ax[1].set_title(f"TM1 vs unannotated seg2: Mann-Whitney p={p1:.2g}; seg2 vs C-term p={p3:.2g}",fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
